title: WP11_SIG_LEN_FALLBACK: replace magic number 512 with named constant
description: C_Sign returns 512 as a conservative signature length when sig_len_max is unknown (WP11_SIG_LEN_UNKNOWN). 512 is correct for RSA-4096 but is a raw magic number with no compile-time constant or explanation. Define WP11_SIG_LEN_FALLBACK in wp11_settings.h or wp11_pkcs11.c and add a comment documenting that it bounds RSA-4096 signatures (4096/8 = 512 bytes).
